name: cherrion
description: End-to-end encrypted notes on Vercel + Postgres: tree hierarchy, block editor, sticky notes and templates.

scripts.build:desktop: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && node desktop/py.mjs desktop/main.py
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build:desktop && node desktop/py.mjs desktop/build.py
scripts.test:desktop: node desktop/py.mjs -m unittest discover -s desktop/tests -t desktop
